summary:
Compiled benchmark scores from results-heldout.jsonl (75 graded trials) + locale-sum frozen artifacts (graded manually). Three candidates measured:

**task-transcript** (27 cases, 10 edge): OFF 0/5 solved (0%); ON-search 7/8 (88%); ON-gated 2/5 (40%).

**overlay-save** (6 cases, 3 edge): OFF 7/11 (64%) solved; ON-gated 9/11 (82%) solved.

**locale-sum** (15 cases, 8 edge — locale format detection): OFF 0/5 solved, 0/8 edge; ON-search 6/6 (100%), 8/8 edge; ON-gated 8/13 (62%), 8/8 edge when solved.

Key signal: ON arm edge-case pass rate vs OFF arm. For locale-sum (cleanest discriminator): OFF = 0% edge (0/40 edge passes across 5 trials), ON-search = 100% edge (48/48). For task-transcript: OFF = 0% edge, ON-search = 87% solve rate. Frozen artifacts are in bench/heldout/frozen/. Results source: bench/heldout/results-heldout.jsonl.

subject: Demo 4: run and publish scores on public programming benchmark
description: Run zonoid against a public programming benchmark (e.g. SWE-bench or similar) to produce external, verifiable proof scores. Publish the protocol including negative results. This is the credibility beat — third-party benchmark, not self-reported.
